_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'clean' (site 1): the composer is C# that registers into DI, so Clean is harmless ambient content here. <AdditionalIsoCode> is deliberately NOT a real market culture such as the docs' zh-HK: on most ICU builds zh-HK already passes Umbraco's stock validator, so a test on it would pass with or without the composer. 'de-JP' is a well-formed BCP 47 tag that ICU does not predefine, so .NET reports it as a UserCustomCulture and stock Umbraco rejects it — AdditionalCulturesTests asserts that precondition first, so the test cannot pass vacuously on any platform.
